extracted.intended_audience: short-story writers, creative-writing readers, and authors submitting to literary venues
extracted.subtask_description: Identify which of several distinct 'engines' (plot, character, voice, setting, premise, mood, image, idea, form, language) will power a short story, and execute all other elements so they support that engine. Guidance is aimed at writers deciding how to shape emphasis and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Desire, antagonism, turning points, spine, progression, crisis, climax (Aristotelian backbone).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize clear causal movement and structural beats: character desire, obstacles, escalation, and resolution. Prioritize pacing and narrative tension; other elements (voice, lyrical description) should not undermine forward motion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character-driven
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on inner life and change: scenes that reveal belief, conflict, and development. Plot can be minimal if it foregrounds psychological shifts; avoid treating characters as mere vehicles for a high-concept premise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Idiosyncratic narrator who carries the reader by sheer presence (e.g., Lorrie Moore, Denis Johnson).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Let the distinct narrator/personal diction do the heavy lifting. Prioritize consistent, compelling narrative persona over intricate plotting or exhaustive worldbuilding. Voice may excuse looseness in other areas so long as it sustains reader engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Place itself shapes events; world dictates story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make setting active: geography, culture, or social milieu should generate conflict and choices. Use specific sensory detail and causal relation between locale and action; avoid generic settings that merely backdrop character action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premise-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: A high-concept hook ("what if…"); the implications carry the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop the logical or emotional consequences of the central premise. The narrative's value is in exploring implications rather than in deep character interiority; don't force heavy psychological realism if the idea's ramifications are the point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mood/atmosphere-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Building unease, awe, dread, tenderness — affect over event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustain tonal and sensory patterns that cultivate a feeling. Prioritize repetition, pacing, and sentence-level craft to maintain mood; plot may be subordinate or elliptical as long as atmosphere remains coherent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: A central recurring image that organizes meaning (Carver's title objects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weave a striking motif or image through the story so it accrues symbolic or emotional weight. Use restraint so the image doesn't become mere ornament; ensure scenes return to or refract the image to create unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Idea-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Story as essayistic exploration of a thought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the narrative as a means to examine an idea or argument. Clarity of thought and progression of inquiry matter more than conventional plot mechanics; beware turning the piece into a lecture—keep narrative anchors to engage readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: Unusual structure (lists, footnotes, fragments) generates meaning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use structural innovation so that form and content illuminate each other. Make formal choices purposeful (not gimmicky); the structure should create constraints or revelations integral to the story's effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language-driven
rubrics_metrics.description: The pleasure is in the prose itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize diction, rhythm, sentence music, and stylistic bravura. Language may justify pared-down plot or character work if the prose sustains interest; avoid obscuring meaning solely for prettiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality criterion: engine coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Whichever engine drives the story, every other element must not fight it. A premise story doesn't need rich character interiority; a voice story doesn't need ornate plotting. Quality = coherence between engine choice and execution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate a story by how well secondary elements are subordinated to and supportive of the chosen engine. Anti-patterns include mismatched emphases (e.g., ornate plotting in a voice piece) and internal conflicts where style, structure, or detail undermine the engine's promise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary fiction valued
rubrics_metrics.description: Lit Hub's publication patterns indicate a preference for literary fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions and examples that align with literary aesthetics (attention to craft, ambiguity, thematic depth) are more likely to fit the venue's taste; commercial genre conventions may be less prioritized unless they intersect with literary concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-genre experimentation welcomed
rubrics_metrics.description: The publication favors work that blends or experiments across genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hybrid forms and boundary-pushing pieces that mix genres or modes are acceptable and encouraged, provided the experimental choices serve the story rather than distract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diverse, international voices
rubrics_metrics.description: Lit Hub tends to publish diverse and international writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voice, viewpoint, and cultural specificity that broaden representation are desirable; strive for authenticity and specificity rather than tokenism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Politically and culturally engaged work
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that engages political and cultural issues is represented in the venue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories with social or cultural resonance are welcome so long as engagement is integrated into craft rather than didactic; nuanced perspective is preferred over polemic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft essays prioritize plurality of approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Lit Hub craft essays accept multiple valid approaches rather than one orthodox method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice emphasizes that different engines and methods can all produce strong stories; writers should choose the approach that fits their material and execute it coherently rather than trying to conform to a single 'correct' technique.
